releases.notes:
# Modules
- **Added BDSM-Mask** - Dispenses carved pumpkins with Curse of Binding onto players/mobs (Thanks to onrc and Pala)
- **Added Handy-Place** - Controls how directional block were to be placed and skinny-block full-cube placement (experimental)
- **ArenaM** - Fixes higher altitude interception, wind-charge interception rewritten against the engine (0.3125 box, computeMargin, reach-sphere candidate) instead of the coarse box-union test.
- **AutoBeacon**/**AutoFarm**/**AutoSex** - Allocation-free distance sorts, throttled scans.
- **AutoLoader** - Added collect-dropped-shulker.
- **AutoPot** - Now can use lingering potions and ominous bottle.
- **AxolotlTools** - Fixed entityInteractionRange being inflated by its own square.
- **B36** - Fixed swap to required items.
- **BlockRadius** - Added sponges absorption range and sulfur geyser erupt timer, split into one class per feature, fixed warden ESP shape.
- **BookshelfFiller** - Added skip-duplicate-books when filling.
- **ChestTracker** - Added copper-chests option, enchantment signature index, async debounced save.
- **ContainerPeek** - Added shelf block tooltips.
- **DoubleCrystalPopper** - Melee rejected on real attack range.
- **DriedGhastPlacer** - Reworked placement to now place in strips.
- **Fatamorgana** - Completion keys on container fullness, not on what fills it.
- **ForceAccess** - Entity boxes use ESP tick interpolation.
- **GetPreview** - No hotbar overlay while the HUD is hidden via F1 key.
- **InventoryTracker** - Nametag-compat: offset above Meteor Nametags, or hide.
- **ItemDespawn** - Entity boxes use ESP tick interpolation.
- **KMDB** - Added right-click-build option for manual-placement instead of needing build-key.
- **MapartNamer** - Fixed one name/coord formula everywhere (the resume filter matched nothing); added index overlay.
- **MaterialsRefill** - Added collect-dropped-shulker.
- **MinecartPlacer** - Fixed the module trying to place outside of rails range.
- **MURADAESA** - Exact-id natural-block allow list, redstone needs two flips, score-ordered markers, per-dimension guards.
- **PacketEat** - Added silent mode.
- **PlatformBuilder** - Added collect-dropped-shulker and build-shape Flat/Walls/Solid with layer build stages.
- **PortalCave** - Allocation-free distance sorts, throttled scans; duplicated render branch collapsed.
- **PzH2000** - Arrow-id cache bounded and reset when the world changes.
- **SculkRange** - Cached solidity set, allocation-free neighbour reads.
- **TrajectoryPlus** - Breadcrumb prune throttled to every 30 frames.

# Mixin
- **BlockStateBaseMixin** - Added full outline for skinny blocks in Handy-Place, somewhat affects vanilla interaction.
- **InGameHudMixin** - Exposes isHudHidden.

# Command
- **BookCommand**/**ShelfCommand**/**IfpeekCommand** - Each now has translation on gui feature.
- **ChestTrackerCommand** - Search for items in tracked containers or export them.

# HUD
- **AsmrRadioHud**/**ElytraTime**/**EntityList**/**NeboM**/
**OnlineFriendsHUD**/**TeleportTimer**/**Weather** - Force-default-font; ElytraTime/EntityList added Starscript text.

# Utils
- **AreaSelector** - Was flat corners only
- **BookUtils** - One translation engine (HTTP pool, throttle, 109 languages).
- **DistanceUtil** - XZ and point-to-box helpers.
- **ForceDefaultFont** - Font choice and measurement in one place.
- **HotbarSwap** - Shared hotbar provisioning (inventory-menu SWAP via SlotUtil.indexToId, empty slot preferred).
- **ItemSignature** - Enchantment-aware stack key.
- **PlacementEngine** - prefer-solid-block now considers a full collision cube, so glass and leaves count.
- **ShelfTooltip** - Vanilla-style shelf tooltip.
- **ShulkerRestockEngine** - DropCollector, carried-slot sync.

# Port
- Added support for Minecraft version 26.3

releases.notes:
# Modules
- **Added ForceAccess** - Mines the block that keeps a container from opening, then opens it, also works through walls.
- **ArenaM** - Added instant-throw & soonest-first throw order.
- **AutoMoss** - Rewrote target scan (cached tree candidates, no per-tick rescans). Cancels Baritone via cancelEverything().
- **BlockRadius** - Added beacon level colours, fill alpha, merge overlap, exclude inactive. Derives warden anger from the synced client value.
- **BookshelfFiller** - Added book-log & hover title/author info on chiseled bookshelves, configurable layout, remember slot while in active filling.
- **ChestTracker** - Quieter manual save, safer data writes, bounded lock on the inline save fallback. Cut ChestTrackerDataV2 sync-save stall from 15s to 2s.
- **DriedGhastPlacer** - Fixed WAIT_BREAK hang.
- **ElytraPath** - Caches the simulated path, re-simulates only on config/heading change lel.
- **GetPreview** - Added show-empty-bar setting and port Bundle filter to 26. versions.
- **InventoryInfo** - Added tooltips, both-sides view, filled-map, and map-ID tooltip. Rebuilds its render cache instead of per frame. Fixes shulker coloured handle.
- **ItemDespawn** - Caches the renderable-item scan.
- **KMDB** - Added Creaking to build modes, new wither and iron golem orientations, added manual-placement setting with preview.
- **LiveMessage** - Now kinda supports RTL/non-Latin lines. Skin caching in ManeWindow. Hardened: no bidi/zero-width in opened URLs, line grapheme cap, capture strip direction controls, debug-rejected-capture, verify-sender-in-tab. Width measurement is code-point aware. NotesWindow Keeps user-typed timestamps, brackets and section signs.
- **MapartNamer** - Added index size/colour visualize-indices so you can see which maps is indexed/getting named
- **MaterialsRefill** - Counts the offhand in the stock check.
- **MobOwner** - Fix caches label/owner lookups.
- **PacketEat** - Added suppress. Resumes auras/Baritone when an emergency is active but has no food to eat.
- **PlatformBuilder** - Caches the flat-area build scan.
- **PressItemFrame** - Added target frame priority.
- **PzH2000** - Added hitbox targeting, adaptive angle step & learning rate, refine-pitch.
- **SignRender** - Refreshes cluster centers on demand.
- **ThrowEmptyShulkers** - Rotation and filter lookup is now a HashSet, rebuilt once per scan.
- **TrajectoryPlus** - Caches simulation & shulker bullet rendering since this update is mostly about cutting down performance cost.

# Command
- **AssignOwnerCommand** - Now suggest online players using OnlinePlayerNameArgumentType but also still accepts custom name.

# HUD
- **ElytraTime**/**EntityList**/**NeboM**/**OnlineFriendsHUD** - Visual fixes.

# Utils
- **ShulkerInfo** - Fix coloured handle, compact view merges stacks by item *and* components, so tooltips keep names, enchants, damage and map data.
- **BookUtils**/**EnemyManager**/**PlacementEngine**/**ShulkerRestockEngine** - Shared-logic clean-ups.

- **BookUtils** - Shared book reading/screen/analysis engine.
- **ShulkerRestockEngine** - Fixes broken hotbar swap action.

releases.notes:
# Modules
- **Added LiveMessage** - Advanced DM management system with GUI in early access,
 integrated with Queue, Enemy, and Notes system.
- **Added SignRender** - Renders sign text through walls with advanced clustering.
- **ArenaM** - Added statistical info accuracy, Switched to ProjectileEntitySimulator because they
 were improved in Meteor 1.21.11 (why didn't anybody tell me :sob: ).
- **AutoSex** - Added Pronouns option (Thanks to BaboBasti)
- **BlockRadius** - Fixes warden visual bug for warden-anger-trend, Fixes beacon culling.
- **BookImporter** - Added RemoteLibrary where you can directly browse my open library github pages,
 i would sometime add books ^^, Added the ability to wrote the group name on signs.
- **ChestTrackerModule** -  Added show on screen, fixes ChestTrackerDataV2 old bug for shulker contents that isnt properly logged which caused the ChestTrackerScreen to go stale.
- **HomesList** - Added rename and delhome feature in the edit screen, Use atomic writes and corrupted file safety.
- **InventoryTracker** - Fixes showing duplicate tools because of durability usage.
- **KMDB** - Added skip occupied and air-place mode, Brings back copper golem mode.
- **MapartNamer** - Fixes clickslot and faulty ClientPlayerInteraction which makes the module broken for long time.
- **MURADAESA** - Now use DistanceUtil, Thanks for reminding me Powie69 :D
- **PacketEat** - Added spam check for foods that doesn't require hunger to stop, Now can eat while opening screens.
- **SculkRange** - Added normal sculk sensor, sculk shrieker to show their range, Added Activation power display and vibration (although its not accurate display for vibration since i don't think feasible currently).
- **ShulkBookRestock** - Added match colour and name filter for shulkers, this applies to keep-one setting.
- **TntFuseEsp** - Brings back the  flashing mixin from numby.
- **ThrowsEmptyShulker** - Added screen check safety.
- **TrajectoryPlus** - Merged back with Meteor Trajectories, switched to ProjectileEntitySimulator instead of old ProjectilePhysic util.

# Hud
- **Added Weather** - Simple weather display just to check for thunder.
- **AnimePics** Added more API sources just like the continuation [here](https://github.com/or4acle/anime-pics). Added metadata (Thanks to BbiBelle for troubleshooting).

# Command
- **Added EnemyCommand** - Manage marked as enemies.
- **Added QueueCommand** - Manage queued (offline-pending) DM messages.

# Mixin
- **Removed BlockedServersMixin** - Since newer Meteor already have **Mojang  server blacklist bypass implementation**
i advice to update the meteor build from [here](https://meteorclient.com/archive)
- **Removed ServerListMixin** - its just adding the 6b6t if not already present
- **Removed ClientPlayerInteractionManagerMixin** - not reliable slot move

# Utils
- **AsmrAudioEngine** - Improved sound quality (supposedly).
- **PlacementEngine** - Added World-Height check.
- **ShulkerRestockEngine** - I swear i almost gave up on this.
